abilities.effect: The mist swiftly decays the flesh of all living creatures in the pit, inflicting 10d6 negative damage (DC 27 basic Fortitude save).
abilities.name: Decay Flesh

traits.name: Divine
traits.text:
This magic comes from the divine tradition, drawing power from deities or similar sources. Anything with this trait is magical.  
  
A creature with this trait is primarily constituted of or has a strong connection to divine magic.

traits.name: Necromancy
traits.text: Effects and magic items with this trait are associated with the necromancy school of magic, typically involving forces of life and death.

abilities.trigger: A creature ends its turn within the mist

hazard.description: Churning vapors of glowing green mist fill a 30-foot-deep chasm.
hazard.disable: DC 28 Religion to counteract Kabriri's influence here by offering prayers to any non-evil deity and causing the mist to disperse, or *dispel magic* (3rd level; counteract DC 23) to counteract the mist for 24 hours
hazard.name: Corpselight Mist
hazard.reset: The hazard resets automatically at the end of a turn and can trigger again the next round.

traits.name: Unique
traits.text: A rules element with this trait is one-of-a-kind. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to creatures with this trait is increased by 10.

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.
